reforms.label: Accessory dwelling units
reforms.subtitle: Wisconsin ADU law · statewide estimates
reforms.benchmark: Allow one ADU on parcels with existing single-family buildings; detached and semi-detached ADUs of at least 600 sq ft; no additional parking required.

reforms.label: Missing middle housing
reforms.subtitle: Wisconsin 2–6 homes per lot · statewide estimates
reforms.benchmark: Allow 2–6 dwelling units on parcels currently restricted to single-family use, heights up to 3 stories. You may assume setback and lot-coverage requirements do not constrain 2–6 units.

reforms.label: Transit-oriented density
reforms.subtitle: Wisconsin transit-oriented density law · statewide estimates
reforms.benchmark: Increase allowable residential density near major transit stops via greater heights and/or floor area ratios. Define "major transit stop" and justify your proximity threshold. You may assume parking requirements are reduced or eliminated.
